_comment: Local stdio only. CANVAS_BASE_URL is the origin only (https://csd509j.instructure.com), no /api/v1. CANVAS_PSEUDONYMIZE_STUDENTS=true swaps student names/emails/SIS ids for stable 'Student N' labels server side; free text inside submissions is NOT scrubbed.
claude_code_cli: claude mcp add canvas-lms --scope user -e CANVAS_API_TOKEN="${CANVAS_API_TOKEN}" -e CANVAS_BASE_URL=https://csd509j.instructure.com -e CANVAS_PSEUDONYMIZE_STUDENTS=true -e CANVAS_ROLE=teacher -- npx -y canvas-lms-mcp
claude_code_plugin: /plugin marketplace add bruchris/canvas-lms-mcp  then  /plugin install canvas-lms-mcp
claude_desktop_alt: Or download canvas-lms-mcp.mcpb from https://github.com/bruchris/canvas-lms-mcp/releases/latest and enable 'FERPA mode' in the install dialog.
skills_install: npx skills add bruchris/canvas-lms-mcp  (or copy ./skills/* into ~/.claude/skills/)
